summary: Phase 4 partially complete: proved neg_bracket_zero_is_vbracket (Lemma 5.1 base case) sorry-free. Inductive step blocked on design issue: the peel-off-first-witness approach from Lemma 5.3 does not generalize to brackets with segment types. splitAt_combine also still sorry (complex Fin index arithmetic). Three sorries total, build passes.

sorry_inventory.assumption: If leftPart holds on (z0, z) and rightPart holds on (z, z1) with pointTypes i at z, then bf holds on (z0, z1)
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Fin index arithmetic with 4-case split (left 0/positive x right 0/positive) and dite conditions. Multiple proof attempts failed on omega/convert issues with computed Fin indices.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Use holds_eq_zero/holds_eq_succ BEFORE simp, not after. Case split on i.val first, then on n - i.val. Avoid rcases n (changes types). Keep Fin indices as raw values.

sorry_inventory.assumption: The negation of a bracket formula with n+1 witnesses is a V-bracket on Prior structures
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: The Lemma 5.3 peel-off-first-witness approach fails for general brackets: finding first alpha_0-occurrence r0 via HasAttainedINF gives not-alpha_0 on (z0,r0) but NOT beta_0 on (z0,r0), so splitAt_combine cannot reconstruct. Need segment-type-based decomposition.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Research correct decomposition: (A) decompose by first segment type failure + Lemma 5.3 for point-type-only sub-case, or (B) prove F-chain reverse direction on Prior structures to reduce to Lemma 5.3 directly.

sorry_inventory.assumption: Full biconditional: V-bracket iff not-exists-z bracket(z_0,z)
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Reverse direction needs Lemma 5.1 proved first
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: After Lemma 5.1: express partial bracket as bracket on (z0,z1) via F-chain, apply Lemma 5.1

blockers: Lemma 5.1 inductive step: need correct decomposition strategy for bracket negation with segment types (the paper's approach assumes endpoint conditions our formalization lacks)
splitAt_combine: Fin index arithmetic proof (solvable but tedious, ~200 lines)

key_design_decisions: BracketFormula.prepend uses dite for Fin proofs; prepend_holds and prepend_holds_inv proved sorry-free
orderedPointsExist_decompose factored as standalone helper for witness combination
VBracketFormula.prependAll constructs negation VBracket syntactically from IH disjuncts
BracketFormula.fChainFrom uses well-founded recursion on (n - i.val) for F-chain construction
neg_partialBracketExist_sufficient proved via Lemma 5.3 composition (one-directional but sorry-free)

CRITICAL: The peel-off-first-witness approach (Lemma 5.3 pattern) does NOT generalize to brackets with segment types. Segment conditions create coupling between left boundary and first witness that HasAttainedINF on point types cannot resolve. The paper avoids this because it puts alpha_0 at the endpoint z_0 itself, while our BracketFormula has ALL witnesses interior to (z_0, z_1).
